data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old English word 'scir' meaning 'bright, clear, or shining', and the Old French word 'le' meaning 'little' or 'light'. The name Shirleen may have originated as a diminutive of the name Shirley or as a name in its own right, meaning 'gentle song or melody'. The name Shirleen carries the meaning “Gentle song or melody” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Shirleen usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle song or melody and live with faith, good character and purpose.
